visual.name: plumeChord
visual.description: Chord diagram with the Plume Studio look: From / To / Value or a matrix of measures, directed ribbons (two-way widths or one arrow per direction) or undirected, overlap-free curved, radial or horizontal labels, ticks, sorting, small flows in Others, self-loops, hover and cross-filter; premium: play axis with animated transitions between periods, bipartite layout (two half circles), in/out, net balance and change ring, net balance and fewer-crossings sorting, stronger-direction colors, small ribbons hidden, percent ticks, grouped (hierarchical) arcs, highlighted groups and gradient ribbons.
